title: Global Commands
intro: `:g/pattern/command` runs a command on every line that matches the pattern; `:v/pattern/command` runs it on every line that doesn't. The classic is `:g/pattern/d` to delete matching lines, but any Ex command works, including `:normal`, which replays Normal-mode keys on each line.
summary: Run a command on every matching line at once.

hints: `:g` finds every line containing `console` and runs `d` on it.

exercises.instruction: Keep only the TODO lines: `:v/TODO/d` + `Enter` deletes every line that does NOT match.

hints: `^$` matches a line with nothing between start and end.

exercises.instruction: Add a semicolon to every `let` line: `:g/let/normal A;` + `Enter`.
exercises.initialCode:
let a = 1
let b = 2
log(a)
let c = 3
hints: `:normal` types the keys after it on each matching line: `A;` appends a semicolon.
Escape the slashes: `:g/\/\//d`, or match on another word such as `:g/old/d`.

exercises.instruction: Keep only the lines that contain `error`.
exercises.initialCode:
info: start
error: disk
info: retry
error: net
hints: Delete the lines that don't match.
